```{ojs}
//| output: false
dados = await FileAttachment("./data/dados.tsv").tsv({ typed: true })
// results = await FileAttachment(`./results/altss/hsalinarum-alTSS.tsv`).tsv({ typed: true })

igv = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/igv@3.0.2/dist/igv.esm.min.js").then(m => m.default)
```

```{r}
#| output: false

dados <- read.table(file = "./data/dados.tsv", sep = '\t', header = TRUE)

results <- list()
samples <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(dados)) {
  results[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read.table(paste0("./altss/", dados[i,]$Filenames, "-alTSS.tsv"), sep = '\t', header = TRUE)
  samples[[dados[i,]$Filenames]] <- read.csv(paste0("./data/samples/", dados[i,]$Filenames, ".csv"), header = TRUE)
}

# ojs_define(dados = dados)
ojs_define(results = results)
ojs_define(samples = samples)


```

## {.toolbar}
    
```{ojs}
viewof species = Inputs.select(dados, {label: "Species", format: x => x.Filenames, value: dados[0]})
```

## Row {height=60%}

### Column {width="35%"}

```{ojs}
fn = species["Filenames"]
sp = species["Species"]
altsstsv = results[fn]
trans = transpose(altsstsv)
console.log("Loaded", trans)

viewof selectedline = Inputs.table(trans, { 
  multiple: false, 
  columns: ["Chromossome", "Position", "Strand", "OriginalFile", "Protein", "Product", "TSSCount", "total_ortho"],
  header: {
    "Chromossome": "NC",
    "Position": "Pos",
    "Strand": "Strand",
    "Protein": "Protein",
    "OriginalFile": "Library",
    "Product": "Function",
    "TSSCount": "n(TSS)",
    "total_ortho": "total_ortho"
  },
  width: {
    "Chromossome": 100,
    "Position": 100,
    "Protein": 50,
    "Strand": 50,
    "OriginalFile": 30,
    "Product": 80, 
    "TSSCount": 30,
    "total_ortho": 30
  }
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

mytracks = [{
    name: "Anotação",
    type: "annotation",
    format: "gff3", 
    url: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.gff`,
    searchable: true
},
{

    type: "annotation",

    url: `http://localhost:8080/altss/${fn}-alTSS.gtf`,

}]


// https://igv.org/doc/igvjs/#tracks
transpose(samples[fn]).forEach(samp => { 
  /* 
  //
  // BAM files are really heavy, but if you want to use them, uncomment this section;

  //
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+`,
    "type": "alignment",

    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired.bam`,
    "indexURL": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired.bam.bai`,
  });
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX-`,
    "type": "alignment",
    "format": "BAM",
    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired.bam`,
    "indexURL": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired.bam.bai`,
  });
  */
  
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ FWD`,
    "type": "wig",
    "format": "bedGraph",
    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
  });
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- FWD`,
    "type": "wig",
    "format": "bedGraph",
    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-fwd.bedgraph`,
  });
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX+ REV`,
    "type": "wig",
    "format": "bedGraph",
    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibP"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
  });
  mytracks.push({
    "name": `${samp["Output"]} TEX- REV`,
    "type": "wig",
    "format": "bedGraph",
    "url": `http://localhost:8080/data/frtc/${fn}/coverage/${samp["LibM"]}-paired-rev.bedgraph`,
  });
})



igvbrowser = {
  const container = document.querySelector("#igv-container");
  const options = {
    reference: {
      id: `${fn}`,
      name: `${sp}`,
      fastaURL: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.fna`,
      indexURL: `http://localhost:8080/data/genomes/${fn}.fna.fai`
    },
    tracks: mytracks
  };
  
  igv.removeAllBrowsers();
  
  return igv.createBrowser(container, options);
}
```
